title: Got a story to share? Be a Cebuano Mover!
summary: Be a Cebuano mover and do stories that matter to your community

blocks.text: Be a Cebuano mover and do stories that matter to your community
CEBU, Philippines – From writing stories that matter to building communities of action, you can be part of Cebu’s growing Movers network today by joining Rappler’s Movers Program.
As a Mover, you will receive mentorship from Rappler and its partners, gain access to exclusive workshops, and collaborate on ground campaigns that drive real change in your community.
Watch this video from the MoveCebu Roadshow and Movers huddle last October 15, 2026, to learn more about the program and how it’s helping Cebuanos make a difference. – Rappler.com
